item_results.note: The alternating face signs give the stated boundary matrix; its Smith form is diag(1,5), yielding exactly the stated homology and torsion.
The homotopy is a strong deformation retraction, the prism identity has the correct endpoint order, and the induced homology isomorphisms are complete.
The equator is a good-pair subspace, the quotient is a wedge of two 2-spheres, and the connecting map (a,b) maps to a-b with the fundamental class mapping to (1,1).

The open-cover hypotheses and reduced H_0 calculation are correct, and the Mayer-Vietoris connecting map identifies the two graph cycles with the displayed basis up to the consistently fixed sign convention.
The CW subcomplex gives a good pair, collapsing the 1-skeleton gives S^2, and abelianizing the commutator attaching word makes the relative connecting map zero as required.
Attaching and characteristic maps are correctly distinguished, the closure-finite and weak-topology conditions are explicit, and the signed cellular boundary is multiplication by m.
Exponent sums give the stated cellular matrix, its Smith form is diag(1,6), and the homology agrees with the abelianized fundamental-group presentation.
The three-sheeted fiber, H_1 matrix, positive degree 3, Smith invariants, and natural comparison among cellular, Delta-complex, and singular homology models are correct.

conclusion: All eight exercises, hints, and complete solutions are mathematically correct and complete.
